title: Repeated GitHub Pages file-sync timeouts delay a validated title revision

source.summary: The bilingual title revision passed build, continuity, payload and sealed-artifact validation; the Pages deployment timed out during file sync.

steps: Run the existing Pages workflow for bfc2383a8219521dbb85cd7c72732f46c186e29d.
All build, preservation, payload and artifact checks pass; upload succeeds.
Deploy remains at syncing_files and exceeds its 600-second timeout.
observed.expected: Deploy the validated artifact, preserve recovery copy and synchronize reader catalog.
observed.actual: Run42828205239 attempt1: build success; deploy failed14:04:03UTC. Last valid state14:03:55UTC syncing_files; timeout14:04:00UTC; deployment canceled14:04:01UTC. Recovery-copy and notify-readers were skipped. Fresh-revision run42830866020 also failed: build success14:10:16UTC; final syncing_files and timeout14:20:29UTC; cancellation14:20:30UTC; deploy failure14:20:32UTC. Recovery-copy and notify-readers skipped.

limitations: The internal cause of the Pages delay is unconfirmed.
The official operational status does not establish success of this deployment.
A prior new-source-version retry succeeded, but this is not proof that a cached build version caused the timeout.

policy_decision.rationale: Record the repeated deployment-service delay separately from editorial validation. Retry once with a new source revision and identical publication inputs. Preserve workflow, security and validation rules.
policy_decision.revisit_when: Next existing ADOPT operations session; inspect provider state and this exact artifact before considering a further retry.

authority.basis: Authorized review revision and ADOPT ongoing operations approved2026-11-08.
authority.current_scope: Failure evidence and one new-source-revision full CI retry; no publication, workflow or security-rule changes.

acceptance_criteria: Record per-attempt results and actual deployment cancellation.
Verify live bilingual HTML, PDFs and historical archive copies against the sealed artifact.
Keep the external delay cause unconfirmed until evidence supports it.

verification.status: Both bounded attempts passed all build checks and failed in Pages file sync; both cancellations verified; publication remains pending.
checks: Both new PDF first pages visually read; the other16 pages RGB-identical.
Scientific manuscripts are byte-identical after H1.
Only intended bilingual HTML/PDF and two archive PDFs changed; other articles and PDFs preserved.
Timeout, cancellation and downstream skips verified from completed job logs.
Actual HTTPS release still50fb320 and article H1 still the previous published title after both attempts.
remaining_limits: The new title is not yet public on the journal site.
The internal Pages sync delay cause remains unconfirmed.
The unchanged-input new-revision experiment did not resolve the stall.

observation.result: Previous public edition remains available; revised source and bilingual PDFs are committed and accessible. No new publication or subscriber-delivery completion is claimed.

recovery.plan_reference: Run the existing workflow once with a fresh source revision containing only this operations record; all publication inputs and checks remain identical.
recovery.result: The single fresh-source-version retry also timed out. Stop repeated retries; keep validated publication inputs, historical editions and original workflow/security checks.

next_action: ADOPT should inspect the confirmed repeated Pages-sync delay at the next existing operations session, using the two exact failed runs and immutable artifacts. Do not assume a cause or weaken validation. The persistent title-revision request is ready for normal deployment when the path recovers; then verify live HTML/PDF, recovery and reader sync.
